about.hero: We help you enjoy Paris with clear, reassuring local support.
about.sectionTitle: A Paris studio for travellers who want peace of mind
about.p1: HMI Paris is a support desk for guests who want to enjoy Paris with confidence. Paris-based Japanese staff arrange tours, private cars, airport transfers, interpreting and custom plans.
about.p2: Almost all site copy — services, fees, news and policies — can be edited in Strapi without changing the frontend.

classic-paris-essentials.title: Classic Paris essentials
classic-paris-essentials.summary: A Louvre morning, Île de la Cité, and an easy afternoon by the Seine.
classic-paris-essentials.description: Three unhurried days: timed Louvre entry, a guided walk on Île de la Cité, and café time by the river.

montmartre-after-dark.title: Montmartre after dark
montmartre-after-dark.summary: Village lanes, Sacré-Cœur at sunset, and a rooftop dinner with city lights.
montmartre-after-dark.description: A twilight walk through quiet Montmartre streets, golden hour at Sacré-Cœur, then rooftop dining.

le-marais-private-walk.title: Le Marais private walk
le-marais-private-walk.summary: Hôtels particuliers, Place des Vosges, and local sweet stops.
le-marais-private-walk.description: A half-day private guide through Le Marais: courtyards, Place des Vosges, and favourite tasting spots.

versailles-royal-day.title: Versailles royal day
versailles-royal-day.summary: Palace, gardens and Trianon — with return transfers from Paris.
versailles-royal-day.description: Skip-the-line palace entry, garden guiding, free time at Marie Antoinette’s hamlet, transfers included.

left-bank-literary-trail.title: Left Bank literary trail
left-bank-literary-trail.summary: Saint-Germain bookshops, café culture, and dusk in the Luxembourg Gardens.
left-bank-literary-trail.description: A gentle route via Shakespeare and Company, Saint-Germain cafés and the Luxembourg Gardens.

seine-twilight-cruise.title: Seine twilight cruise
seine-twilight-cruise.summary: The Eiffel Tower, Musée d’Orsay and Notre-Dame from the river at night.
seine-twilight-cruise.description: Evening boarding, champagne on board, landmarks from the water. Riverside dinner optional.

arc-de-triomphe-2026.title: Prix de l’Arc de Triomphe 2026 viewing bus tour
arc-de-triomphe-2026.label: Shared bus tour
arc-de-triomphe-2026.badgeText: 2026 10.4 SUN Arc de Triomphe viewing bus tour
arc-de-triomphe-2026.summary: The 105th Prix de l’Arc de Triomphe at Longchamp — top jockeys and horses, with a Japanese-speaking guide.
arc-de-triomphe-2026.description: A special bus tour to watch the Qatar Prix de l’Arc de Triomphe at Longchamp. Experience European racing atmosphere up close, with Japanese guidance even if it’s your first race day.
arc-de-triomphe-2026.notes: Programme may change with weather or race conditions. Details are confirmed at booking.

paris-christmas-lights-2026.title: Paris Christmas lights evening stroll
paris-christmas-lights-2026.label: Seasonal tour
paris-christmas-lights-2026.summary: Champs-Élysées, Opéra and other winter light spots with a Japanese-speaking guide.
paris-christmas-lights-2026.description: Paris wrapped in lights at year-end. Enjoy markets and window displays on a safe evening walk — private or small group.
paris-christmas-lights-2026.notes: Dates may adjust for weather or crowds.
